modNamingContent: IDs are automatically prefixed with your project tag, so they never clash with vanilla. Naming conflicts resolve themselves. On export, descriptor.mod and the standard folder layout are generated for you. You just create.
emptyState: No projects yet. Start from scratch, or import an existing mod to rework.
confirmDeleteProject: Are you sure you want to delete this project?
modNameHint: Start with just a name. You'll add countries after opening the project.
supportedVersionHint: The HOI4 engine version your mod targets — written to descriptor.mod as supported_version. 1.19.* covers every 1.19.x patch. Defaults to the latest; you can change it later in Mod Descriptor settings.

baseModShelf.sectionHint: Build on top of a base mod to reference its characters, focuses and art — or start from scratch.
